facts.text: Business Central supports Windows authentication and SQL Server authentication for database access.
Windows authentication is configured by default on server instance and database.
SQL Server authentication requires an encryption key to protect credentials.
Create encryption key using New-NAVEncryptionKey cmdlet in admin shell.
Import encryption key using Import-NAVEncryptionKey cmdlet on server instance and database.
Configure SQL Server instance to mixed authentication mode to support SQL authentication.
Create SQL login and map to database user with relevant privileges.
Encryption key file is stored in ProgramData with filename serverinstance.key.
